ASPD_FALLBACK_GW.note: Replaced by ASPD_FALLBACK, which adds a third option (2: thrust based airspeed estimation). 0 and 1 keep their meaning.

COM_POSCTL_NAVL.note: Removed; when navigation accuracy is lost in Position mode, the vehicle always falls back to Altitude mode (the old value 0). "Land mode (descend)" (1) is no longer available.

EKF2_RNG_A_IGATE.note: Had no effect: the EKF never read it. Removed.

FW_AT_SYSID_AMP.note: Removed; fixed-wing autotune now finds the amplitude of the identification signal itself, by raising it until a target rate is reached.

MPC_HOLD_DZ.note: Renamed to MAN_DEADZONE (same meaning, same default 0.1). Not converted; set MAN_DEADZONE to the old value.

MPC_XY_MAN_EXPO.note: Removed; the stick exponential curve is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.6).

MPC_YAW_EXPO.note: Removed; the stick exponential curve is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.6).

MPC_Z_MAN_EXPO.note: Removed; the stick exponential curve is now fixed in the code at the old default (0.6).

NPFG_EN_MIN_GSP.note: Removed in the fixed-wing position control rework; the airspeed is now always raised to keep the minimum ground speed FW_GND_SPD_MIN while following a course (the old value 1).

NPFG_GSP_MAX_TK.note: The track keeping logic for excess wind (raising the minimum ground speed with the track error) was removed in the fixed-wing position control rework.

NPFG_TRACK_KEEP.note: The track keeping logic for excess wind (raising the minimum ground speed with the track error) was removed in the fixed-wing position control rework.

NPFG_WIND_REG.note: Removed in the fixed-wing position control rework; there is no switch for raising the airspeed in excess wind any more. Keeping the minimum ground speed FW_GND_SPD_MIN is always on; track keeping is gone (see NPFG_TRACK_KEEP).

RD_MAX_THR_YAW_R.note: Replaced by RO_YAW_RATE_CORR, a correction factor for the yaw rate feedforward instead of a yaw rate in m/s. Do not copy the value.

RD_MISS_SPD_GAIN.note: Replaced by RO_SPEED_RED, which reduces the speed by the course error instead of the waypoint transition angle. Both default to -1 (off).

RM_MAX_THR_YAW_R.note: Replaced by RO_YAW_RATE_CORR, a correction factor for the yaw rate feedforward instead of a yaw rate in m/s. Do not copy the value.

RM_MISS_SPD_GAIN.note: Replaced by RO_SPEED_RED, which reduces the speed by the course error instead of the waypoint transition angle. Both default to -1 (off).

RWTO_HDG.note: Removed; the takeoff ground roll always follows a line from the start position: in a mission towards the takeoff waypoint (like the old value 1), otherwise along the heading at the start. Holding the initial heading (0) is no longer available.

RWTO_NPFG_PERIOD.note: The separate guidance period for steering on the runway is gone. v1.16.2 used it for the takeoff ground roll and blended it in during the landing flare; v1.17.0 uses the general guidance settings (NPFG_PERIOD) for both.

UUV_DIRCT_PITCH.note: Removed when the UUV attitude control was reworked: the fixed test inputs (UUV_INPUT_MODE "Direct Feedthrough" with UUV_DIRCT_*) and the option to skip the controller are gone. Manual control has its own modes, scaled by UUV_MGM_* (manual), UUV_SGM_* (attitude) and UUV_RGM_* (rate).
